Chart steps绘图步骤

Each chart shows one terminal. All charts use the same month range. This layout is called small multiples.每张图展示一个航站楼，月份范围一致。这种排列方式称为 small multiples。

Monthly values and counting rules当月数值与统计口径

Choose a month or point to a chart to read its values. Counts are passenger movements; the same person may be counted more than once. A gap means no source record, not zero; * marks a subtotal with missing arrival or departure records.选择月份或在图上点选，查看各图下方的当月数值。统计单位为人次，同一人可能多次计入。断线表示无原始记录，不代表零；* 表示小计缺少到达或出发记录。

Steps and answer步骤与答案
  1. Line 1 already calculates the highest count, maximum.第一行已经算出最高人次 maximum。
  2. Change the last line, return []. It should return the months with that count.修改最后一行 return []，让它返回达到最高人次的月份。
